hero.heading: Short Culinary Courses in Dhaka
hero.subheading: Acquire high-demand specialty skills in under 4 weeks. Ideal for home bakers, chefs expanding their menu, and food entrepreneurs.

overview.title: Acquire Niche Culinary Mastery
overview.text:
A full-term culinary diploma is a major commitment. If you are a specialized food entrepreneur, housewife, or working professional seeking specific skills, our short courses provide intensive hands-on execution without the fluff.

Our kitchen labs in Dhanmondi run specialized batches led by industry veterans. Learn authentic international standards, ISO-HACCP hygiene, and ingredient costing.

highlights.title: Specialty Skills
highlights.description: Sushi rolling, Korean Bulgogi, Sourdough Pizza, Artisan Cakes.

highlights.title: High Margins
highlights.description: Learn commercial costing to maximize food business profits.

highlights.title: Bilingual Classes
highlights.description: Bilingual support (English & Bengali) for easy learning.

faqs.question: What is the schedule for these short courses?
faqs.answer: We offer weekend-only classes (Friday/Saturday) for busy professionals, as well as weekday afternoon options.

faqs.question: Do I get a certificate after completing a short course?
faqs.answer: Yes. Culinary Academy awards a Specialty Institutional Certificate upon successful completion and recipe testing.

faqs.question: How do I register for a class?
faqs.answer: You can submit an online application via our Admission portal or visit our Dhanmondi campus to secure your seat.
